class.name: AbilityTask
class.brief_description: Something an ability waits for, shaped for await - and cancelled with the ability.
class.description: Unreal needs AbilityTasks because C++ and Blueprints have no coroutines: every "wait for X" is an object with callbacks. GDScript has [code]await[/code], so the waiting is free; a task adds the two things [code]await[/code] cannot do by itself. [b]It dies with its ability.[/b] When the ability ends - finished, cancelled, or a prediction the server refused - every task it runs is cancelled, and a cancelled task never emits [signal completed]: its connections are dropped, so a coroutine suspended on it is released and the code after its [code]await[/code] never runs. No [code]if not get_is_active(): return[/code] to remember after every wait. [b]Some waits cross the network.[/b] [method GameplayAbility.sync_target_data] carries a value from the predicting client to the server's copy of the same activation. Made by [GameplayAbility]'s [code]wait_*[/code] methods: [codeblock] func _activate_ability() -> void: if not commit_ability(): end_ability(true) return # Released early, or held to the limit - whichever comes first. var which: int = await wait_any([wait_input_release(), wait_delay(2.0)]).completed var aim: Dictionary = await sync_target_data({ "dir": aim_direction() }).completed ... end_ability(false) [/codeblock] For a task of your own, extend this class, override [method _activate] (and [method _tick] with [method set_ticking]), call [method finish] when done, and start it with [method GameplayAbility.run_task].

method.name: _activate
method.description: Called once when the task starts. Call [method finish] here if it is already done.

method.name: _on_end
method.description: Called once when the task finishes or is cancelled - where to disconnect anything it connected to.

method.name: _tick
method.description: Called every physics frame while running, when [method set_ticking] is on.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends the task without emitting. Whatever awaits it is released and never resumes.

method.name: finish
method.description: Ends the task with [param result]. [signal completed] is emitted at once when something is awaiting it, and at the end of the frame otherwise - a task that finishes while it is being created (a tag that is already there) would otherwise emit before the [code]await[/code] for it began.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Whether it finished with a result.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Started, and neither finished nor cancelled.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once, with the result, when the task finishes - never when it is cancelled. [code]await task.completed[/code] evaluates to [param result].
